CommandHelp.ACMD: [join|restart|jointeam TeamName] [command 1] :: [command 2]...: Execute a command for the specified action. (using :: instead of ; e.g., acmd join addperk perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding :: spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)
CommandHelp.AddTeam: [Team Name]: Add a team with the specified name.
CommandHelp.AllPlayer: Get info on all players in the current lobby.
CommandHelp.AllowCheats: [True|False] Controls whether players can enable cheat mode
CommandHelp.AllowPVP: [True|False] Controls whether PvP between players is allowed
CommandHelp.BindSync: [True|False] Controls whether newly joined players will have their Trinkets and Bindings synced. This setting does not affect players who are already in the lobby.
CommandHelp.ChangeModel: [Model name]: Model switching doesn’t take effect in-game, and the developer doesn’t know how to model — it won’t look good anyway, so just make do.
CommandHelp.CheatsTest: [Number]: This is not for you — it's a test function for MPMod developers, all in Chinese, and affects game balance.
CommandHelp.Host: [Lobby Name] [Visibility=public|friends|private] [Max Player=8]:Lobby Name is used for others to search for the lobby (it cannot contain spaces or ;). Visibility controls whether the lobby can be found by others.
CommandHelp.Invite: Open the Steam overlay to invite your friends.
CommandHelp.Join: [Lobby Name|Lobby id]:The name or ID of the lobby to join. It will first try to match by name; if no match is found, it will fall back to matching by ID.
CommandHelp.LobbyId: Get the current lobby ID and copy it to the clipboard.
CommandHelp.LobbyType: [Visibility=public|friends|private]:Visibility controls whether the lobby can be found by others.
CommandHelp.PCMD: [all|steamId] [command 1] :: [command 2]...: Execute a command for all players or a specific player. (using :: instead of ; e.g., pcmd 561198279116422 addperk perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding :: spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)
CommandHelp.PlayerColor: [Preset|R G B]: Change the remote player model color. Presets: default, white, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, pink, black.
CommandHelp.PlayerColorInvalidRgb: RGB values must be integers in the range 0-255.
CommandHelp.PlayerColorSet: Remote player color set to RGB({0}, {1}, {2}).
CommandHelp.RemoveTeam: [Team Name]: Remove the team with the specified name. (default team cannot be removed)
CommandHelp.SetLobbyName: [Lobby Name]: Lobby Name is used for others to search for the lobby (it cannot contain spaces or ;).
CommandHelp.SetName: [Name]: Set the name displayed on your tag to others.
CommandHelp.TCMD: [teamname] [command 1] :: [command 2]...: Execute a command for all players in the specified team. (using :: instead of ; e.g., tcmd hunter addperk perk_u_t3_peripheralbinding :: spawnentity item_artifact_evaglove)
CommandHelp.Talk: [Text]: Send a message to other players.
CommandHelp.TeamRule: [Team A] [Team B] [Rule Name] [true|false|default]: Set team rules. (e.g., teamrule A B pvp true , A C hang true grab true)
CommandHelp.Test: [Number]: This is not for you — it's a test function for MPMod developers, all in Chinese, but does not affect game balance.
CommandHelp.TpTo: [steamId]: Match using the ID from allplayer (suffix matching, e.g., tpto 22 for target steamId 561198279116422).
